title: Summand comparison cocycles for a simultaneous flat-tower resolution
statement: Let Y be a scheme, P and Pprime cochain complexes of its module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], both actual flat telescopes [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map], and f:P→Pprime a cochain map. There are bounded-above termwise-flat towers E0,E1,E2, transitions t0,t1,t2 and level maps a:E0→E1, b:E0→E2 whose sum maps commute with the telescope differentials φj. There are maps r1:Cone(φ1)→P and r2:Cone(φ2)→Pprime whose homotopy-category images are isomorphisms. There are quasi-isomorphisms qn:E0n→τ≤nP [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], strictly compatible into P. Put s=Σdesc(qn;ιn), Aj=Σmap(a or b), Lj=Cone.inl(φj), Rj=Cone.inr(φj), and s1=s, s2=s;f. There are cochains αj:ΣE0→Pj of degree -2 and βj:ΣE0→Pj of degree -1, for P1=P and P2=Pprime, satisfying 0=δαj+φ0;βj+Aj;(Lj;rj) and ofHom(sj)=δβj+ofHom(Aj;Rj;rj). All compositions involving Lj are cochain compositions. This asserts summand data only: no source-cone augmentation or equality of maps from the source cone is a conclusion.

source.place: lem-sc-flat-telescope-arrow-diagram, geometric construction in steps 1--2 and retained homotopy components of step 3; simultaneous comparisons are that plan's agent expansion, not a literal Stacks lemma.

proof.text: Apply strict bar augmentation data. Take all four comparison cochains to be zero. The zero shifted target restrictions give the first and third equations; applying ofHom to the strict unshifted sum identities and reversing gives the other two. Preserve all tower properties.

proof_origin.place: Algebraic zero-cochain consequence of strict bar augmentation data; no geometric construction is left in this module.
